title: Add query-priority proxy and instrumentation fidelity controller
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: reduce query-side tail and cost by routing observability queries by priority and by dynamically adjusting instrumentation fidelity (span sampling, metric cardinality) based on live query load and alert budget. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a small, lightweight query-priority proxy that tags and routes incoming observability queries (Grafana/Prometheus/console) into high/standard/low priority lanes and enforces backpressure and soft-throttles low-priority queries when ingestion or query budget is constrained; 2) an instrumentation fidelity controller that adjusts sampling factors and cardinality knobs for tracing and high-cardinality metrics across tenants based on an alert budget and query load signal. The description below is a single contiguous narrative: Changes: implemented src/proxy/query_priority_proxy.go: request tagging, tenant priority policy, rate-limiter adapter, metrics for queueing and drop counts; added fidelity controller service in observability/fidelity/controller.py that subscribes to query-proxy telemetry and computes per-tenant fidelity profiles, exposes a REST control endpoint and feature-flag hook; added console/dashboard panels dashboards/query-fidelity-overview.json and dashboards/query-priority-lane.json; added runbook runbooks/query-priority-fidelity-runbook.md and a short e2e test suite tests/observability/fidelity_e2e_test.go. Design highlights: the proxy is intentionally inline and stateless; fidelity decisions are made by a single leader per region and stored in the existing policy store (kv/policy_store). The controller uses a cost budget model (tokens) derived from billing rate and a configurable alert-safety margin. Rollout and rollback: feature-flagged by tenant with default off; canary rollout to 5 internal tenants, then 50, then full. Fallbacks: when the controller is not available the system preserves current sampling config and the proxy falls back to standard lane with no throttling. Testing and validation: unit tests for policy evaluation and sampling math, integration tests that exercise query backpressure under synthetic load, microbench for proxy throughput (sustains ~8k qps on an m5-like instance in test harness). Observability: new metrics added for query_lane_requests_total, query_lane_drops_total, fidelity_change_events_total, estimated_telemetry_cost_saved; dashboards include cost-estimate sparklines per tenant and an alert that fires if fidelity adjustments produce more than X% of dropped traces for high-priority lanes. Migration notes: existing alerts that rely on raw high-cardinality metrics should be reviewed; default fidelity profile is conservative to avoid missed alerts. Security: controller REST endpoint authenticated with existing service identity tokens; no new data plane access added. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests and e2e smoke - [x] Docs and runbook included - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Bench results attached - [x] Security review comment addressed
